about: Hometowns kept by hand, for athletes whose feeds give a birthplace that isn't their hometown, or nothing at all. Each one says where it came from. These outrank every feed; only an operator's word outranks them. Academies are boarding schools whose town isn't anyone's hometown: a high school on this list counts for little.

hometowns.name: Sam Darnold
hometowns.note: Played at San Clemente High School. ESPN gives his birthplace, Capistrano Beach, 4 miles away.

academies: Athol Murray College of Notre Dame
